title: Where the Error Lives: Spectral Representations of Learned Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians
abstract: arXiv:2610.37843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) is the standard method for computing the electronic structure of molecules and materials, but its self-consistent-field (SCF) iterations make it expensive for large systems and high-throughput screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonian models offer a shortcut: an equivariant network predicts the Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian matrix in one forward pass, and diagonalizing the prediction yields orbital energies, the HOMO-LUMO gap, molecular orbitals and the electron density. These models are trained to match the reference matrix entry by entry, yet a small entry-wise error does not guarantee accurate eigenvalues or eigenvectors. Two physics-informed alternatives go partway: a recently proposed wavefunction-alignment loss adds a spectral penalty without diagonalizing the prediction, and matching the electron density of the diagonalized prediction supervises it directly. translated_title: 误差存在于何处：学习型Kohn-Sham哈密顿量的谱表示
translated_abstract: Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（DFT）是计算分子和材料电子结构的标准方法，但其自洽场（SCF）迭代使得大体系和高通量筛选的计算代价高昂。机器学习哈密顿量模型提供了一条捷径：等变神经网络通过一次前向传播即可预测Kohn-Sham哈密顿量矩阵，对该预测矩阵进行对角化便可得到轨道能量、HOMO-LUMO间隙、分子轨道和电子密度。这些模型通常通过逐元素匹配参考矩阵进行训练，然而较小的逐元素误差并不能保证特征值或特征向量的准确性。两种基于物理信息的替代方法只能部分解决该问题：近期提出的波函数对齐损失在不显式对角化预测矩阵的情况下引入了谱惩罚，而匹配对角化后预测的电子密度则提供了直接的监督信号。但两者都不够完整：通过表示……
tldr: 本文研究了机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量预测误差在谱域中的分布规律，指出逐元素误差无法保证特征值和特征向量的准确性，并论证了现有波函数对齐损失与电子密度匹配两类物理约束方法均不完备。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes where errors live in the spectral representation of machine-learned Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians, showing that small entry-wise errors do not guarantee accurate eigenvalues or eigenvectors, and that existing physics-informed losses (wavefunction alignment and electron density matching) are each incomplete.
